data.html_title: Web3 Design Principles: Building Trust in Decentralized Apps (2026)
data.html_description: Master Web3 UX. From wallet connections to gas fees, learn the 7 core design principles that build trust and adoption in decentralized applications.
data.description: Let's be honest - Web3 still scares people. The idea of managing your own keys, paying gas fees for a button click, and staring at a transaction hash that looks like a cat walking across a keyboard is not exactly a warm welcome.
